title: Essilor International SA - completed acquisition of a majority interest in Eyebiz Laboratories Pty Limited

timeline.event: Luxottica announced that Essilor had acquired a majority interest in Eyebiz.
ACCC commenced a public review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
ACCC requested further information from the target. ACCC timeline suspended.
ACCC received further information from target. ACCC timeline recommenced.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the completed acquisition.

body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC considered the completed acquisition in the context of the following markets: - the national market for the supply of ophthalmic lens processing services; - the national market for the supply of ophthalmic lenses; and - local markets for the retail supply of optical dispensing services.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC concluded that the completed acquisition would be unlikely to result in a substantial lessening of competition in any relevant market for the following reasons: - pre-acquisition, Eyebiz exclusively supplied lens processing services to Luxottica retail outlets, however it would now be able to supply lens processing services to non-Luxottica retailers; - the completed acquisition would involve a direct transfer of Luxottica's lens processing volumes from Eyebiz to Essilor and would therefore be unlikely to impact the existing structure of the market; - Eyebiz appeared to have acquired limited volumes of ophthalmic lenses from suppliers other than Essilor, and the completed acquisition appeared to formalise existing supply arrangements; - there appeared to be a number of independent (non-integrated) lens processing laboratories available to rival suppliers of ophthalmic lenses. Further a number of suppliers of ophthalmic lenses were also vertically integrated into the supply of lens processing services; and - there appeared to be a number of independent lens processing laboratories available to independent retail customers.
